# keycard_organization (Data Source)

Returns the Keycard organization that the authenticated identity belongs to.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Fetch the organization the authenticated identity belongs to
data "keycard_organization" "this" {}

# Use the organization's builtin zone to create resources scoped to it
resource "keycard_policy_set" "org_default" {
  zone_id     = data.keycard_organization.this.zone_id
  name        = "org-default"
  target_type = "zone"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the organization.
- `label` (String) A domain name segment for the organization.
- `name` (String) Display name for the organization.
- `sso_enabled` (Boolean) Whether SSO is enabled for the organization.
- `zone_id` (String) Unique identifier of the builtin zone for the organization.
